## 🚦 Status Overview
One landing page for **what the backend has been doing** — data ingests, availability polls, and watches — newest first. Click a row's linked cell to **drill into the detail dashboards**, or use a run's **Logs** link to scope the backend log panel at the bottom (sets the `log_filter` variable to that run id).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.active) AS active_pollers,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.active) AS dormant_pollers,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.active AND p.next_run_at <= now()
    AND (p.claimed_until IS NULL OR p.claimed_until < now())) AS due_now,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.claimed_until IS NOT NULL
    AND p.claimed_until >= now()) AS in_flight
FROM availability_poller p;

SELECT
  p.id AS poller_id,
  CASE
    WHEN NOT p.active THEN 'dormant'
    WHEN p.claimed_until IS NOT NULL AND p.claimed_until >= now() THEN 'in_flight'
    WHEN p.next_run_at <= now() THEN 'due_now'
    ELSE 'waiting'
  END AS poller_status,
  count(DISTINCT wp.watch_id) AS watches,
  p.provider,
  p.parent_ref,
  p.poi_id,
  p.next_run_at,
  p.claimed_until,
  p.last_run_at,
  p.last_force_pull_at
FROM availability_poller p
LEFT JOIN availability_watch_poller wp ON wp.poller_id = p.id
GROUP BY
  p.id,
  p.active,
  p.claimed_until,
  p.next_run_at,
  p.provider,
  p.parent_ref,
  p.poi_id,
  p.last_run_at,
  p.last_force_pull_at
ORDER BY
  (p.active AND p.claimed_until IS NOT NULL AND p.claimed_until >= now()) DESC,
  (p.active AND p.next_run_at <= now()
    AND (p.claimed_until IS NULL OR p.claimed_until < now())) DESC,
  p.active DESC,
  p.next_run_at ASC NULLS LAST,
  p.id DESC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM availability_run WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)) AS runs,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM availability_run
     WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND status = 'failed') AS failed_runs,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM availability_fetch_call
     WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND outcome = 'rate_limited') AS rate_limited,
  (SELECT COALESCE(sum(snapshot_count),0) FROM availability_run
     WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)) AS snapshots,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT rp.poi_id)
     FROM availability a
     JOIN reservable_pois rp ON rp.reservable_id = a.reservable_id
     WHERE $__timeFilter(a.last_observed_at)) AS "poi updated",
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT a.reservable_id)
     FROM availability a
     WHERE $__timeFilter(a.last_observed_at)) AS "reservables updated",
  (SELECT count(*) FROM availability 
     WHERE $__timeFilter(last_observed_at) AND previous_id > 0) AS db_updates,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM availability 
     WHERE $__timeFilter(last_observed_at)) AS total_db_updates;

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  r.id AS run_id,
  r.poller_id,
  r.status AS run_status,
  r.snapshot_count,
  count(fc.id) AS fetch_calls,
  count(fc.id) FILTER (WHERE fc.outcome = 'rate_limited') AS rate_limited,
  r.duration_ms AS duration,
  r.error,
  r.started_at,
  r.completed_at
FROM availability_run r
LEFT JOIN availability_fetch_call fc ON fc.run_id = r.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.started_at)
GROUP BY
  r.id,
  r.poller_id,
  r.status,
  r.snapshot_count,
  r.duration_ms,
  r.error,
  r.started_at,
  r.completed_at
ORDER BY r.started_at DESC, r.id DESC
LIMIT 300;

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  a.last_observed_at AS transitioned_at,
  r.loop || ' / ' || r.name AS reservable_name,
  a.target_date::text AS date,
  prev.status AS from_status,
  a.status AS to_status,
  a.run_id
FROM availability a
LEFT JOIN availability prev ON prev.id = a.previous_id
JOIN reservables r ON r.id = a.reservable_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(a.last_observed_at)
  AND a.previous_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY a.last_observed_at DESC, a.id DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT $__timeGroup(created_at, '$__interval') AS time,
       provider || ':' || parent_ref AS metric,
       count(*)::double precision AS value
FROM availability_fetch_call
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND outcome = 'rate_limited'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: ② Availability polling — what got fetched

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'active') AS active,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'paused') AS paused,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'done')   AS done
FROM availability_watch;

SELECT
  w.id AS watch_id,
  w.status AS watch_status,
  CASE
    WHEN count(DISTINCT wt.id) = 0 THEN NULL
    WHEN count(DISTINCT wt.id) FILTER (WHERE wt.poi_id IS NOT NULL) > 0
     AND count(DISTINCT wt.id) FILTER (WHERE wt.reservable_id IS NOT NULL) > 0 THEN 'mixed'
    WHEN count(DISTINCT wt.id) FILTER (WHERE wt.poi_id IS NOT NULL) > 0 THEN 'poi'
    ELSE 'reservable'
  END AS scope,
  count(DISTINCT wt.id) AS target_count,
  array_agg(
    DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN wt.poi_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'poi:' || wt.poi_id::text
      WHEN wt.reservable_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'reservable:' || wt.reservable_id::text
    END
  ) FILTER (WHERE wt.id IS NOT NULL) AS scope_ids,
  w.start_date,
  w.end_date,
  w.cadence_sec,
  w.trigger_kinds,
  w.stop_when_triggered,
  count(DISTINCT p.id) AS pollers,
  min(p.next_run_at) FILTER (WHERE p.active) AS next_run_at,
  max(p.last_run_at) AS last_run_at,
  w.created_at
FROM availability_watch w
LEFT JOIN availability_watch_poller wp ON wp.watch_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN availability_poller p ON p.id = wp.poller_id
LEFT JOIN availability_watch_target wt ON wt.watch_id = w.id
GROUP BY
  w.id,
  w.status,
  w.start_date,
  w.end_date,
  w.cadence_sec,
  w.trigger_kinds,
  w.stop_when_triggered,
  w.created_at
ORDER BY
  (w.status = 'active') DESC,
  next_run_at ASC NULLS LAST;

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
(
  SELECT count(DISTINCT target)
  FROM ingest_runs
  WHERE phase_kind = 'target'
    AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
) AS targets,

(
  SELECT count(*)
  FROM ingest_runs
  WHERE phase_kind = 'target'
    AND status = 'completed'
    AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
) AS "completed runs",

(
  SELECT count(*)
  FROM ingest_runs
  WHERE phase_kind = 'target'
    AND status IN ('failed', 'aborted')
    AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
) AS "failed runs",

(
  SELECT count(*)
  FROM ingest_runs
  WHERE phase_kind = 'target'
    AND status = 'started'
    AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
) AS "stuck runs",

(
  SELECT max(completed_at)
  FROM ingest_runs
  WHERE phase_kind = 'target'
    AND status = 'completed'
) AS "Last Completed";

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT ir.*, row_number() OVER (
    PARTITION BY ir.target, ir.phase
    ORDER BY ir.started_at DESC, ir.id DESC) AS rn
  FROM ingest_runs ir
  WHERE ir.phase_kind = 'import'
)
SELECT target, --phase AS run_kind,
       started_at as age, -- completed_at,
       extract(epoch FROM completed_at - started_at) * 1000 AS duration,
       (counts::jsonb ->> 'seen')::int AS count,
       notes,
       status
FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY started_at DESC;

SELECT
  child.id,
  child.parent_run_id,
  parent.target,
  parent.phase AS run_kind,
  child.phase,
  child.phase_kind,
  child.status,
  child.started_at,
  child.completed_at,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(child.completed_at, now()) - child.started_at)) * 1000 AS duration,
  child.exit_code,
  child.counts,
  child.notes
FROM ingest_runs child
LEFT JOIN ingest_runs parent ON parent.id = child.parent_run_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(child.started_at)
  AND child.phase_kind <> 'target'
  AND (
    child.status IN ('failed', 'aborted')
    OR (child.status = 'started' AND child.started_at < now() - interval '30 minutes')
  )
ORDER BY child.started_at DESC, child.id DESC
LIMIT 300;
